Privacy overview

Updated 23 October 2026

Fulfillment Workspace is in development. This information site does not ask visitors to sign in or submit order information. The Etsy integration is not active.

Planned data use

If Etsy API access is approved and the application is launched, each seller will choose whether to authorize their own shop through Etsy OAuth. The pilot is intended to use authorized shop order data only to review fulfillment requirements, prepare supplier data for BurgerPrints, and record operational results. Shop data will be separated by seller. Access scope, retention period, support contact, and deletion process must be finalized before live use.

What this site collects

This static page has no forms, account system, or application analytics code. The hosting provider may process standard request logs to serve the page.

Questions

Contact details will be added before the application is opened to users. Until then, this page is a project overview for developer registration.
